description: Unrecognized activation strings leave the forward callable unset rather than producing an explicit configuration error.
trigger: An external caller constructs an otherwise valid ordinary MLP with activation_fn="relu", then calls forward.
expected_behavior: Reject the unsupported selection during construction or provide a defined activation.
actual_behavior: Neither match arm assigns activation_fn_call; forward attempts to access it after the up projection. No in-tree ordinary MLP constructor caller was found, so reach is limited to the exposed API rather than a demonstrated model workflow.

verification.description: Compared the complete patch with the parent MLP implementation and searched the whole parent tree for MLP references; inspected transformer forward consumers.
verification.limits: No constructor or forward execution; external callers were not inspected.
